```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(readr)

# Project root: edit to your own directory
base_dir <- dirname(dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input())))

source(file.path(base_dir, "code", "apa_helpers.R"))

tab_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "code", "apa_output", "tables", "study1")
fig_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "code", "apa_output", "figures", "study1")
```

# Load data and prepare variables

Reads the cleaned, de-identified data frame produced by `interomap_data_prep.R`.
Z-scored outcomes are standardised within the whole study, so coefficients are
comparable across metrics. Valence and intensity are the per-pixel **average**
metrics (`avg_valence_combined`, `avg_intensity_combined`).

```{r load-prepare}
df <- read_csv(file.path(base_dir, "data", "processed", "interomap_study1_data.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE)

# Private demographics (one row per PID), used only for the Demographics table.
demo_path <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "processed", "interomap_study1_demographics.csv")
have_demographics <- file.exists(demo_path)

if (have_demographics) {
  df <- df |>
    left_join(read_csv(demo_path, show_col_types = FALSE), by = "PID")
} else {
  df <- df |>
    mutate(Age = NA_real_,
           Gender = NA_character_,
           `Cultural background` = NA_character_,
           `Racial lineage` = NA_character_)
}

# Gender coding scheme (code 3 = self-described, free text).
gender_levels <- c("Non-binary", "Woman", "Man", "Self-described/Other",
                   "Don't know", "No answer")

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    # Ensure Gender has every level in the scheme (code 3 is otherwise NA).
    Gender = factor(replace_na(as.character(Gender), "Self-described/Other"),
                    levels = gender_levels),
    # Pre-registered outcomes (z-scored for modelling).
    avg_valence_z             = as.numeric(scale(avg_valence_combined)),
    avg_intensity_z           = as.numeric(scale(avg_intensity_combined)),
    extent_log_z              = as.numeric(scale(log(extent_combined + 1))),
    valence_by_extent_log_z   = as.numeric(scale(log(valence_by_extent_combined + 1))),
    intensity_by_extent_log_z = as.numeric(scale(log(intensity_by_extent_combined + 1))),
    # Exploratory spatial outcomes (z-scored for modelling).
    centroid_x_front_z        = as.numeric(scale(centroid_x_front)),
    centroid_y_front_z        = as.numeric(scale(centroid_y_front)),
    sd_x_front_z              = as.numeric(scale(sd_x_front)),
    sd_y_front_z              = as.numeric(scale(sd_y_front)),
    entropy_15_front_z        = as.numeric(scale(entropy_15_front)),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post")),
    group     = factor(group, levels = c("non_gambler", "gambler")),
    PID       = factor(PID)
  )

# Raw (untransformed) columns for descriptives and distribution plots.
pre_reg_raw <- c(
  "Average Valence"     = "avg_valence_combined",
  "Average Intensity"   = "avg_intensity_combined",
  "Extent"              = "extent_combined",
  "Valence x Extent"    = "valence_by_extent_combined",
  "Intensity x Extent"  = "intensity_by_extent_combined"
)

exploratory_raw <- c(
  "Centroid x"       = "centroid_x_front",
  "Centroid y"       = "centroid_y_front",
  "SD x"             = "sd_x_front",
  "SD y"             = "sd_y_front",
  "Entropy (15)"     = "entropy_15_front"
)

# Z-scored outcome columns used in the models.
pre_reg_specs <- c(
  "Average Valence"           = "avg_valence_z",
  "Average Intensity"         = "avg_intensity_z",
  "Extent (log)"              = "extent_log_z",
  "Valence x Extent (log)"    = "valence_by_extent_log_z",
  "Intensity x Extent (log)"  = "intensity_by_extent_log_z"
)

exploratory_specs <- c(
  "Centroid x"       = "centroid_x_front_z",
  "Centroid y"       = "centroid_y_front_z",
  "SD x"             = "sd_x_front_z",
  "SD y"             = "sd_y_front_z",
  "Entropy (15)"     = "entropy_15_front_z"
)

all_specs <- c(pre_reg_specs, exploratory_specs)

# LME with Satterthwaite df.
fit_lme <- function(dv, data) {
  lmer(as.formula(paste(dv, "~ timepoint * group + (1 | PID)")),
       data = data, REML = TRUE)
}

# Satterthwaite-df fixed effects, formatted for an APA table (Wald 95% CI).
lme_effects_table <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  labels <- c("Intercept", "Timepoint (post)", "Group (gambler)",
              "Timepoint x Group")
  data.frame(
    Parameter = labels,
    b         = round(s[, "Estimate"],   2),
    SE        = round(s[, "Std. Error"], 2),
    df        = round(s[, "df"],         1),
    t         = round(s[, "t value"],    2),
    p         = fmt_p(s[, "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    `95% CI`  = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]",
                        s[, "Estimate"] - 1.96 * s[, "Std. Error"],
                        s[, "Estimate"] + 1.96 * s[, "Std. Error"]),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Mean (+/- 1 SE) by group and timepoint, for a given (z-scored) outcome.
means_plot <- function(data, dv, label) {
  data |>
    group_by(timepoint, group) |>
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE),
              se   = sd(.data[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean, colour = group, group = group)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.1) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = paste0(label, " (z)"), colour = "Group") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Histograms of raw values, faceted by metric.
distribution_plot <- function(data, specs) {
  data |>
    select(all_of(unname(specs))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = unname(specs), labels = names(specs))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4A90A4", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Raw value", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

# Demographics

Age, gender, cultural background and racial lineage, split by gambling group.
Education and employment are not reported.

```{r demographics}
if (have_demographics) {
  demo <- df |>
  filter(timepoint == "pre") |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("non_gambler", "gambler"),
                        labels = c("Non-Gambler", "Gambler")))

groups <- c("Non-Gambler", "Gambler")

gender_labels   <- gender_levels
cultural_labels <- c("African", "European", "East Asian", "South Asian",
                     "South East Asian", "Hispanic or Latinx", "Indigenous",
                     "Middle Eastern", "Other", "Don't know",
                     "Prefer not to answer")
racial_labels   <- c("Asian", "Black", "European/White", "Hispanic", "Indigenous",
                     "Pacific Islander", "Other", "Don't know",
                     "Prefer not to answer")

# Percentages rounded (largest remainder) so they sum to exactly 100%.
pct_sum100 <- function(counts) {
  n <- sum(counts)
  tenths <- floor(1000 * counts / n)
  remainder <- as.integer(round(1000 - sum(tenths)))
  frac <- 1000 * counts / n - tenths
  idx <- order(frac, counts, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(remainder)]
  tenths[idx] <- tenths[idx] + 1
  tenths / 10
}

# Gender is single-select: count each level (zero counts shown).
count_pct <- function(x, labels) {
  vals <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ",")))
  vals <- vals[nzchar(vals)]
  cnt  <- as.numeric(table(factor(vals, levels = labels)))
  setNames(sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", cnt, pct_sum100(cnt)), labels)
}

# Cultural background and racial lineage are multi-select. Each participant is
# counted once per column: single selections are reported as themselves and
# multiple selections as one row per unique combination, so percentages sum to
# exactly 100%.
combo_counts <- function(x, labels) {
  parsed <- lapply(replace_na(as.character(x), ""), function(z) {
    s <- trimws(strsplit(z, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
    s <- s[nzchar(s) & s %in% labels]
    if (length(s)) s[order(match(s, labels))] else character(0)
  })
  keys <- vapply(parsed, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
  keys <- keys[lengths(parsed) > 0]
  cnt  <- table(keys)
  setNames(sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", cnt, pct_sum100(cnt)), names(cnt))
}

# Order rows: single selections first, then combinations.
combo_order <- function(keys, labels) {
  parsed   <- strsplit(keys, ", ", fixed = TRUE)
  ranks    <- lapply(parsed, function(s) match(s, labels))
  size     <- lengths(ranks)
  rank_str <- vapply(ranks, function(r) paste(sprintf("%02d", r), collapse = ""), character(1))
  keys[order(size, rank_str)]
}

rows <- list()
rows[["Age, mean (SD)"]] <- sapply(groups, function(g) {
  x <- demo$Age[demo$group == g]
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
})
for (lab in gender_labels) {
  rows[[paste0("Gender \u2014 ", lab)]] <-
    sapply(groups, function(g) count_pct(demo$Gender[demo$group == g], gender_labels)[[lab]])
}

add_multi_rows <- function(rows, var, labels) {
  by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) combo_counts(demo[[var]][demo$group == g], labels))
  keys <- combo_order(unique(c(labels, unlist(lapply(by_group, names)))), labels)
  for (k in keys) {
    rows[[paste0(var, " \u2014 ", k)]] <-
      sapply(by_group, function(v) if (k %in% names(v)) v[[k]] else "0 (0.0%)")
  }
  rows
}
rows <- add_multi_rows(rows, "Cultural background", cultural_labels)
rows <- add_multi_rows(rows, "Racial lineage", racial_labels)

demo_tab <- data.frame(Characteristic = names(rows),
                       `Non-Gambler`  = sapply(rows, `[`, 1),
                       Gambler        = sapply(rows, `[`, 2),
                       check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)

  cat(apa_tab_caption("Demographics by Group (Study 1)"), "\n")
  apa_table(demo_tab, "study1_demographics", tab_dir)
} else {
  cat("Demographics are not included in the shared data file.\n")
}
```

# Descriptives: pre-registered metrics

Mean (SD) in raw units, by group and timepoint. Average Valence and Average
Intensity are per-pixel means on a 1–11 scale (6 = neutral).

```{r descriptives-pre-reg}
pre_reg_desc <- df |>
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post"),
                            labels = c("Pre", "Post")),
         group     = factor(group, levels = c("non_gambler", "gambler"),
                            labels = c("Non-Gambler", "Gambler"))) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(unname(pre_reg_raw)),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = unname(pre_reg_raw),
                         labels = names(pre_reg_raw))) |>
  group_by(metric, timepoint, group) |>
  summarise(txt = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = txt) |>
  arrange(metric, timepoint) |>
  rename(Metric = metric, Timepoint = timepoint)

cat(apa_tab_caption("Pre-registered Outcomes by Group and Timepoint (Study 1)"), "\n")
apa_table(pre_reg_desc, "study1_descriptives_prereg", tab_dir)
```

# Pre-registered models

Each pre-registered outcome is modelled with

$$\text{outcome}_z \sim \text{timepoint} \times \text{group} + (1 \mid \text{PID})$$

using `lmerTest::lmer` with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. Extent and the two
extent-products are log-transformed before standardising, to reduce skew.

```{r fit-lme, results='hide'}
study1_lme <- setNames(lapply(all_specs, function(dv) fit_lme(dv, df)),
                       all_specs)
```

```{r report-pre-reg, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (nm in names(pre_reg_specs)) {
  dv <- pre_reg_specs[[nm]]
  cat("\n### ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Model:** `", dv, " ~ timepoint * group + (1 | PID)`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(apa_tab_caption(paste0("Linear Mixed Model Fixed Effects \u2014 ", nm, " (Study 1)")), "\n")
  print(apa_table(lme_effects_table(study1_lme[[dv]]),
                  paste0("study1_lme_", dv), tab_dir))
  cat("\n\n*Note.* b = unstandardised coefficient (outcome in SD units); Wald 95% CI; df = Satterthwaite degrees of freedom.\n\n")
  p <- means_plot(df, dv, nm)
  cat("\n", apa_fig_embed(p, paste0("study1_means_", dv), fig_dir), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(apa_fig_caption(paste0("Mean ", tolower(nm), " (z-scored) by timepoint and group \u2014 Study 1")), "\n\n")
}
```

# Pre-registered t-tests

For completeness, the t-tests specified in the pre-registration are also reported:
a paired t-test of pre vs post within each group, and an independent (Welch)
t-test on change scores between groups. The linear mixed models above remain the
primary analyses.

```{r prereg-ttests, results='asis'}
run_paired_ttest <- function(data, dv, grp) {
  d <- data |>
    filter(group == grp) |>
    select(PID, timepoint, value = all_of(dv)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) |>
    filter(!is.na(pre), !is.na(post))
  tt <- t.test(d$post, d$pre, paired = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    group = grp,
    n = nrow(d),
    mean_change = mean(d$post - d$pre),
    t = unname(tt$statistic),
    df = unname(tt$parameter),
    p = tt$p.value,
    ci_lo = tt$conf.int[1],
    ci_hi = tt$conf.int[2]
  )
}

run_between_ttest <- function(data, dv) {
  change <- data |>
    select(PID, group, timepoint, value = all_of(dv)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) |>
    filter(!is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |>
    mutate(change = post - pre)
  g  <- change |> filter(group == "gambler")     |> pull(change)
  ng <- change |> filter(group == "non_gambler") |> pull(change)
  tt <- t.test(g, ng, var.equal = FALSE)
  data.frame(
    n_gambler = length(g),
    n_non_gambler = length(ng),
    mean_change_gambler = mean(g),
    mean_change_non_gambler = mean(ng),
    t = unname(tt$statistic),
    df = unname(tt$parameter),
    p = tt$p.value,
    ci_lo = tt$conf.int[1],
    ci_hi = tt$conf.int[2]
  )
}

paired_rows <- lapply(names(pre_reg_specs), function(nm) {
  bind_rows(
    run_paired_ttest(df, pre_reg_specs[[nm]], "gambler"),
    run_paired_ttest(df, pre_reg_specs[[nm]], "non_gambler")
  ) |> mutate(outcome = nm)
}) |> bind_rows()

between_rows <- lapply(names(pre_reg_specs), function(nm) {
  run_between_ttest(df, pre_reg_specs[[nm]]) |> mutate(outcome = nm)
}) |> bind_rows()

paired_tab <- paired_rows |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("non_gambler", "gambler"),
                   labels = c("Non-Gambler", "Gambler")),
    t = round(t, 2),
    df = round(df, 1),
    p = fmt_p(p),
    `Mean change` = round(mean_change, 2),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi)
  ) |>
  select(Outcome = outcome, Group = group, n, `Mean change`, t, df, p, `95% CI`)

between_tab <- between_rows |>
  mutate(
    t = round(t, 2),
    df = round(df, 1),
    p = fmt_p(p),
    `Change, non-gambler` = round(mean_change_non_gambler, 2),
    `Change, gambler` = round(mean_change_gambler, 2),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi)
  ) |>
  select(Outcome = outcome, `n (non-gambler)` = n_non_gambler,
         `n (gambler)` = n_gambler, `Change, non-gambler`,
         `Change, gambler`, t, df, p, `95% CI`)

cat(apa_tab_caption("Paired t-Tests (Pre vs Post) by Group \u2014 Study 1"), "\n")
apa_table(paired_tab, "study1_ttest_paired", tab_dir)
cat("\n*Note.* Outcomes z-scored within study, so mean change is in SD units. Reported for completeness per the pre-registration; the linear mixed models are the primary analyses.\n\n")

cat(apa_tab_caption("Independent t-Tests on Change Scores (Gambler minus Non-Gambler) \u2014 Study 1"), "\n")
apa_table(between_tab, "study1_ttest_between", tab_dir)
cat("\n*Note.* Welch t-test on post - pre change scores (SD units). Reported for completeness per the pre-registration.\n")
```

# Exploratory models

The same model, applied to the exploratory front-view spatial outcomes.

```{r report-exploratory, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (nm in names(exploratory_specs)) {
  dv <- exploratory_specs[[nm]]
  cat("\n### ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Model:** `", dv, " ~ timepoint * group + (1 | PID)`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(apa_tab_caption(paste0("Linear Mixed Model Fixed Effects \u2014 ", nm, " (Study 1)")), "\n")
  print(apa_table(lme_effects_table(study1_lme[[dv]]),
                  paste0("study1_lme_", dv), tab_dir))
  cat("\n\n*Note.* b = unstandardised coefficient (outcome in SD units); Wald 95% CI; df = Satterthwaite degrees of freedom.\n\n")
  p <- means_plot(df, dv, nm)
  cat("\n", apa_fig_embed(p, paste0("study1_means_", dv), fig_dir), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(apa_fig_caption(paste0("Mean ", tolower(nm), " (z-scored) by timepoint and group \u2014 Study 1")), "\n\n")
}
```
